about_the_game:
"Between Two Worlds, Old Souls Reunite; The Fragrance Lingers, Only You Remain Faithful."
Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese-style suspense puzzle game and the seventh installment in the acclaimed Paper Bride series.

This time, we'll follow a new protagonist, temporarily stepping away from the Bodhisattva of Death and Zangling Village to embark on a fresh story. While it may seem unrelated at first, deeper connections likely exist beneath the surface. Familiar faces from Paper Bride 3: Mandarin Pact will also make special appearances throughout this journey.

The new installment brings several exciting upgrades:
* Folk Culture Enhancement — Featuring the same beloved traditional folklore elements fans have come to expect.
* Storyline Expansion — Beloved characters from the Paper Bride universe return in meaningful roles, not merely as Easter eggs.
* Visual Refinement — Everything is heightened: beauty becomes more breathtaking, handsomeness more striking, ugliness more disturbing, and strangeness more unsettling.
* Suspense Intensification — Though veterans may feel immune to our scares by now, we still recommend playing before bedtime!

"May yearning hearts find each other, as your beloved awaits beneath the golden bridge."
Thank you for your unwavering support and passion for the Paper Bride series! We've always striven to create an authentic Chinese folklore experience, and this installment goes even further. Beyond the rich cultural traditions, prepare for encounters with fast-moving paper "creatures" and plenty of surprising (and startling) moments!

We eagerly await your journey into Paper Bride 7: Forever Yours~

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 7sp1 or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6550 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GT440（512M）or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 7sp1 or Windows 10
  • Processor: I3 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX560se or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
